From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sara Barnes <sara.barnes@aureliahealth.com>, Kevin Murphy <kevin.murphy@aureliahealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, Apr 1, 2027 at 3:12 PM PDT
Subject: Mutual Action Plan — legal redlines, SLA ownership & turnaround

Hi Sara / Kevin —

Thanks again for the call today. I attached the initial Mutual Action Plan (Aurelia_MAP_v1.xlsx) with the milestones we talked through. Below is a short, actionable summary so we can lock owners and turnaround times for the legal redlines milestone. Please confirm you and Aurelia Legal are aligned on the dates or let us know if you need a formal extension.

High-level MAP items (legal redlines milestone):
- Owner (initial redline): Aurelia Legal (legal@aureliahealth.com) — deliver annotated redline back to Redwood by EOD Apr 6, 2027 (requested).
- Redwood response: Redwood legal (Naomi Feldman) to provide annotated reply + counter-redline within 48 business hours of receipt.
- SLA/technical clarifications: Karthik Iyer (Redwood) to assess SLA/data residency asks and reply within 72 hours of the redline delivery.
- Commercial items & procurement: Ben Carter to coordinate pricing/contract terms and handle procurement checklist.
- Dependencies: final SOC2 report (we will share), security questionnaire completion (Aurelia to return), and confirmation of data residency requirements.
- Target close (current): Apr 22, 2027 — contingent on redline cadence above.

Attachments in this thread: Aurelia_MAP_v1.xlsx (MAP draft), we will circulate an MSA redline template once we have Aurelia's initial edits.

Next steps I propose:
1) Aurelia Legal to confirm whether Apr 6 is workable for the initial redline (or propose a date).
2) If extended, we will commit to the 48h/72h turnaround windows listed above and update the MAP timeline.
3) Ben/Naomi/Karthik — please confirm ownership here so I can update the MAP and HubSpot deal.

Thanks,

Tessa Morgan
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
T: (415) 555-0119 | tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com
Redwood Inference — inference that scales

Subject: Re: Mutual Action Plan — legal redlines, SLA ownership & turnaround

Tessa —

Appreciate the clear rundown and the MAP file. Two quick notes from our side:

1) Our GC just advised she won't be available until Tuesday (Apr 6) to do a proper redline review. Can we push the Aurelia deliverable to Fri Apr 8? That gives us a little buffer but keeps things moving.

2) One substantive question flagged by our legal/infra team: data residency and partitioning. Specifically, we need confirmation that logs/PKV will be retained in-region (US) and that tokens are logically partitioned per-tenant for audit. Can Redwood confirm whether that is covered in the SLA or if we should treat it as a redline item?

I've attached a short list of legalclarifying questions (Aurelia_legal_questions.pdf) — most are typical MSA points but there are a few SLA/data items we want called out.

If Apr 8 works, we will share the initial redline on or before end-of-day Apr 8.

Thanks — Sara

Sara Barnes
Head of Partnerships | Aurelia Health
sara.barnes@aureliahealth.com

Subject: Re: Mutual Action Plan — legal redlines, SLA ownership & turnaround

Tessa / team —

Thanks — I support accepting Aurelia's request to push their initial redline to Apr 8. Suggested commitments from our side (to be communicated back to the customer):

- Accept Aurelia initial redline on Apr 8. Redwood legal (Naomi) to produce an annotated response + counter-redline within 48 business hours (deliverable: MSA_redline_annotated.docx).
- Karthik to lead SLA/technical responses: target 72 hours after we receive the redline to answer data residency/partitioning questions and any infra-level asks. If Karthik needs infra support, he'll loop infra-eng; flagging that as a dependency for timeline.
- Procurement/commercial churn: I will collate outstanding procurement docs and confirm the purchasing path (SOW vs PO) — target internal procurement checklist done by Apr 12.

Proposed updated MAP milestone dates (to reflect the Apr 8 extension):
- Aurelia redline received: Apr 8, 2027
- Redwood legal reply: Apr 10, 2027 (48h)
- SLA tech assessment: Apr 13, 2027 (72h after reply window begins)
- Target contract close (updated): Apr 29, 2027 — keeps one buffer week for exec signoff and DocuSign.

Dependencies and blockers:
- Aurelia to return signed security questionnaire and clarify any in-region log retention needs.
- We will share our SOC2 summary and a redline-friendly MSA template when Naomi posts the annotated reply.

Naomi / Karthik — please confirm you can meet the 48h / 72h commitments from Apr 8, and I will update HubSpot and the MAP spreadsheet.

Thanks,
Ben Carter

Sara / Team —

Thanks for the heads up and the questions. Confirming our commitments:

- Redwood accepts Aurelia's Apr 8 delivery date for initial redlines.
- I will produce an annotated redline and a short comment matrix within 48 business hours of receipt (expected deliverable by Apr 10 if we receive your redline on Apr 8).
- Karthik will publish a separate SLA response addressing data residency/partitioning within 72 hours after the redline packet is received (we'll call that Apr 11).
- We will include a specific SLA clause draft for in-region log retention and a recommended audit log retention window — if that meets Aurelia's needs, we can bake it into the MSA.

I will upload the annotated redline to the MAP folder and post a DocuSign-ready MSA link here once Ben confirms procurement details.

Proposed next sync: Apr 12, 2027, 10:00 AM PT — 15 min to review redline outcomes and next steps. If that works for Aurelia, please confirm and we'll send a calendar invite.

Thanks,
